sections.title: UCHealth and Academic Medical Center AI
sections.description: UCHealth (University of Colorado Health, Aurora CO HQ adjacent Denver) — Colorado's most research-intensive health system.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act-compliant clinical prediction
paragraphs: All healthcare AI in Colorado that makes or supports high-risk automated decisions about individuals must comply with SB24-205's impact assessment and consumer disclosure requirements — ClickMasters designs UCHealth's clinical prediction AI with Colorado AI Act compliance from the first architecture decision, not as a post-deployment retrofit.

blocks.heading: Altitude-adjusted clinical AI
paragraphs: UCHealth operates at 5,280 feet — Denver's altitude creates physiological differences (higher hemoglobin levels, different oxygen saturation norms, altered cardiac parameters) that standard national clinical AI models don't account for. ClickMasters calibrates Denver clinical AI to altitude-adjusted reference ranges documented in UCHealth's and University of Colorado medical research.

blocks.heading: Oncology precision medicine
paragraphs: ML for the University of Colorado Cancer Center (NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, Aurora CO) — tumor genomics analytics, immunotherapy response prediction, and clinical trial analytics for one of the Mountain West's premier cancer research programs.

sections.title: Centura/CommonSpirit Colorado Clinical AI
sections.description: CommonSpirit Health Colorado (formerly Centura Health) — 17 hospitals across Colorado serving urban Denver and rural Colorado communities.

blocks.heading: Colorado rural health analytics
paragraphs: ML for the healthcare needs of rural Colorado communities served by CommonSpirit's large rural hospital network — the specific health challenges of Colorado's rural and frontier communities (agricultural injuries, altitude illness, long transport distances for emergency care) create clinical AI requirements that urban-calibrated models underserve.

blocks.heading: Colorado Medicaid (Health First Colorado) analytics
paragraphs: ML for the managed care organizations serving Colorado's Medicaid program — population health stratification and care management prioritization for the managed care plans participating in Colorado's Accountable Care Collaborative.

blocks.heading: Behavioral health integration AI
paragraphs: Colorado's ambitious behavioral health system reform (SB21-137 and subsequent legislation) has created specific behavioral health integration requirements for Colorado's general acute care hospitals — ML for screening, warm handoff, and follow-up coordination.

blocks.heading: Outdoor health and active lifestyle analytics
paragraphs: ML for the digital health companies serving Denver's highly active population — wearables analytics, training optimization, and the altitude-specific physiological monitoring applications that are unique to Colorado's outdoor sports-focused digital health market.

blocks.heading: Cannabis and behavioral health digital products
paragraphs: Colorado's mature legal cannabis market intersects with behavioral health in ways that have created specific digital health product demand — harm reduction apps, cannabis use disorder screening, and the behavioral health analytics for Colorado's unique substance use landscape.

sections.title: HealthONE (HCA Colorado)

blocks.heading: HCA ecosystem analytics
paragraphs: ML integrated with HCA's clinical information infrastructure for HealthONE's Colorado hospitals — the same operational analytics deployed across HCA's 180+ hospital national network, adapted to Colorado's specific regulatory requirements including the CO AI Act.

sections.title: Colorado healthcare AI regulatory context
sections.description: Key regulatory considerations for healthcare AI development in Colorado.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act (SB24-205)
paragraphs: Colorado's AI Act is the US's most comprehensive state AI law for high-risk automated systems. Healthcare AI in Colorado that makes consequential decisions about individuals requires: a pre-deployment impact assessment, consumer disclosure when AI is used in high-stakes decisions, and ongoing monitoring. ClickMasters designs all Denver healthcare AI with Colorado AI Act compliance as a non-negotiable design requirement.

blocks.heading: Colorado Behavioral Health Administration
paragraphs: Colorado's reorganized behavioral health system (the new Colorado Behavioral Health Administration was created by SB21-137) creates new data sharing frameworks and outcome measurement requirements for behavioral health AI.
